criteria.deficiency: (1) Duplicate names render every tab instead of keeping the last tab per name, which the spec states. (2) With no tabs, the underline moves to row 1 instead of row 2 (the reference keeps the line break). (3) The Key-propagation change blocks App-level bindings while Tabs has focus.
